plan.title: SRC-REV-001 — RFQ bid revision from 100 to 90

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with two bids without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's event list.
Revise Vendor A's existing 100 bid to 90 and submit the revised quote.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revised bid and shows the round as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's Responses tab to inspect the revised bid and response set.
Confirm both RFQ vendor responses remain visible to the buyer after Vendor A's revision.
Check that the buyer-side response view exposes the expected revision count.
Check that the revised quote is identified as the current second bid when that trail is rendered.
Open Master QCS to verify the revised bid used for comparison.
Confirm both real vendor columns are present in the comparison grid.
Assert Master QCS uses Vendor A's revised unit rate of 90.
